description: Synthetic PH fact-check-style training pairs for the Phase 0 fine-tune probe. Written for training only: events are hypothetical, no named real individuals, topics deliberately disjoint from fixtures/phase0.json (which stays held out). Each claim has evidence that supports it and evidence that contradicts it; 'unrelated' examples come from pairing with another topic's evidence, plus the hand-written same-topic 'hardUnrelated' snippets.

claims.claim: Classes in all levels are suspended in Metro Manila tomorrow because of the typhoon.
claims.supports: The Metro Manila Development Authority announced that classes in all levels, public and private, are suspended in the 17 cities and one municipality of the capital region tomorrow due to the typhoon.
claims.contradicts: The education department clarified that no region-wide suspension was issued; only some cities suspended preschool classes, and the circulating announcement is fake.
claims.hardUnrelated: PAGASA said the typhoon is expected to make landfall over northern Luzon and will bring moderate to heavy rains for the next three days.

claims.claim: Tataas na raw ang pamasahe sa MRT-3 simula sa susunod na linggo.
claims.supports: Inaprubahan ng Department of Transportation ang dagdag-singil sa MRT-3, na magsisimula sa susunod na Lunes ayon sa abiso ng pamunuan ng tren.
claims.contradicts: Nilinaw ng pamunuan ng MRT-3 na walang inaprubahang taas-pasahe at mananatili ang kasalukuyang singil ngayong taon.
claims.hardUnrelated: Pansamantalang lilimitahan ang biyahe ng MRT-3 sa Linggo dahil sa maintenance ng riles, ayon sa abiso.

claims.claim: May price cap na daw ang bigas, P40 kada kilo na lang sa lahat ng palengke.
claims.supports: Ipinatupad na ng pamahalaan ang price ceiling na P40 kada kilo para sa regular milled rice sa lahat ng pamilihan simula ngayong araw.
claims.contradicts: Walang inilabas na kautusan para sa P40 na price cap sa bigas; ayon sa Department of Agriculture, nananatili sa P45 hanggang P52 ang presyo ng regular milled rice.
claims.hardUnrelated: Inaasahang darating ang dagdag na angkat na bigas sa susunod na buwan para punan ang kakulangan sa suplay, ayon sa ahensiya.

claims.claim: Driver's licenses are now valid for ten years for all drivers.
claims.supports: Under the new rules, drivers without traffic violations in the past five years can renew their licenses with a validity of ten years.
claims.contradicts: The transport office said ten-year validity applies only to drivers with no violations; all other drivers still receive licenses valid for five years.

claims.claim: Libre na daw ang PhilHealth contribution ng lahat ng senior citizens starting this month.
claims.supports: Under the expanded law, all senior citizens are automatically covered by PhilHealth and no longer pay monthly contributions, the agency confirmed.
claims.contradicts: Hindi totoo na wala nang babayaran ang lahat; ayon sa PhilHealth, may mga senior citizen pa ring kailangang magbayad ng kontribusyon kung sila ay may trabaho pa.
claims.hardUnrelated: Maglalabas ang PhilHealth ng bagong ID cards para sa mga miyembro sa susunod na taon.

claims.claim: Nagtaas ang singil ng kuryente ngayong buwan.
claims.supports: Inanunsyo ng distribution utility na tataas ng 45 sentimo kada kilowatt-hour ang singil sa kuryente ngayong buwan dahil sa mas mataas na generation charge.
claims.contradicts: Bababa ang singil sa kuryente ngayong buwan ng 30 sentimo kada kilowatt-hour, ayon sa distribution utility.

claims.claim: There will be a 12-hour water interruption in parts of Quezon City on Saturday.
claims.supports: The water concessionaire advised residents of several barangays in Quezon City that service will be interrupted from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Saturday for pipe repairs.
claims.contradicts: The water concessionaire said the advisory circulating online is old and that no service interruption is scheduled in Quezon City this weekend.

claims.claim: Approved na raw ang P200 na dagdag sa minimum wage sa NCR.
claims.supports: The regional wage board approved a P200 increase in the daily minimum wage for workers in the National Capital Region, effective next month.
claims.contradicts: Ayon sa wage board, P35 lang ang inaprubahang dagdag sa arawang minimum wage sa NCR, hindi P200.
claims.hardUnrelated: Labor groups held a rally in Manila on Monday calling for better working conditions and job security.

claims.claim: Monday has been declared a special non-working holiday nationwide.
claims.supports: The Palace issued a proclamation declaring Monday a special non-working day throughout the country.
claims.contradicts: No proclamation has been issued; Monday remains a regular working day, the Palace said.

claims.claim: Magsisimula ang pasukan sa mga pampublikong paaralan sa unang linggo ng Hunyo.
claims.supports: Inilabas ng Department of Education ang school calendar: magbubukas ang klase sa mga pampublikong paaralan sa Hunyo 2.
claims.contradicts: Ayon sa school calendar ng DepEd, sa huling linggo ng Hulyo pa magsisimula ang klase sa mga pampublikong paaralan.

claims.claim: Taal Volcano's alert level has been raised to Alert Level 3.
claims.supports: PHIVOLCS raised the alert status of Taal Volcano to Alert Level 3 after a phreatomagmatic eruption early Tuesday.
claims.contradicts: Taal Volcano remains under Alert Level 1, PHIVOLCS said, adding that the photos of a large eruption plume shared online are from a previous year.
claims.hardUnrelated: Tourism officials in Batangas reported a rise in weekend visitors to lakeside resorts.

claims.claim: May big-time rollback daw sa gasolina this week, P5 per liter.
claims.supports: Oil companies announced a rollback of P5.10 per liter on gasoline effective Tuesday, the biggest reduction this year.
claims.contradicts: Oil firms will implement a price increase of P1.20 per liter on gasoline this week, not a rollback.

claims.claim: The tax filing deadline has been extended to the end of May.
claims.supports: The revenue bureau extended the deadline for filing annual income tax returns to May 31 because of system downtime.
claims.contradicts: The revenue bureau said there is no extension and taxpayers must file their annual returns by April 15.

claims.claim: Hindi na kailangan ng appointment para kumuha ng passport.
claims.supports: Inanunsyo ng Department of Foreign Affairs na tumatanggap na ang lahat ng consular office ng walk-in applicants para sa passport, kahit walang appointment.
claims.contradicts: Paalala ng DFA: kailangan pa rin ang online appointment para sa passport application; tanging mga senior citizen at PWD ang may courtesy lane.
claims.hardUnrelated: Bubuksan ng DFA ang bagong consular office sa isang mall sa Cebu sa susunod na buwan.

claims.claim: Makakatanggap ng P10,000 na cash aid ang lahat ng 4Ps beneficiaries ngayong Disyembre.
claims.supports: Inaprubahan ng DSWD ang one-time P10,000 na cash assistance para sa lahat ng 4Ps households, na ibibigay bago mag-Pasko.
claims.contradicts: DSWD said there is no P10,000 Christmas cash aid for 4Ps beneficiaries and warned the public against fake posts asking for personal details.

claims.claim: A dengue outbreak has been declared in the province.
claims.supports: The provincial health office declared a dengue outbreak after cases rose by 300 percent compared with the same period last year.
claims.contradicts: Health officials said dengue cases are rising but remain below the outbreak threshold, and no outbreak has been declared.

claims.claim: Nakakagaling daw ng dengue ang pag-inom ng katas ng dahon ng papaya.
claims.supports: Ayon sa isang pag-aaral, nakatulong ang katas ng dahon ng papaya para gamutin at tuluyang mapagaling ang dengue.
claims.contradicts: Walang sapat na ebidensya na nakakagaling ng dengue ang katas ng dahon ng papaya, ayon sa Department of Health; dapat pa ring magpakonsulta sa doktor.
claims.hardUnrelated: Inirerekomenda ng DOH ang paglilinis ng mga lalagyan ng tubig para hindi pamugaran ng lamok.

claims.claim: All flights at NAIA were cancelled on Friday.
claims.supports: The airport authority cancelled all domestic and international flights at NAIA on Friday because of the typhoon.
claims.contradicts: Only 24 domestic flights were cancelled at NAIA on Friday; international flights operated normally, the airport authority said.

claims.claim: Bawal na daw bumiyahe ang mga traditional jeepney simula next month.
claims.supports: The transport regulator confirmed that unconsolidated traditional jeepneys will no longer be allowed to operate starting next month.
claims.contradicts: Ayon sa LTFRB, walang phaseout ng traditional jeepney sa susunod na buwan at maaari pa ring bumiyahe ang mga may prangkisa.

claims.claim: SSS pensioners will receive a 13th and 14th month pension this year.
claims.supports: The state pension fund confirmed that pensioners will receive both a 13th month pension in December and an additional 14th month pension this year.
claims.contradicts: The state pension fund said pensioners will only receive the regular 13th month pension in December; there is no 14th month pension this year.

claims.claim: Sinara na ang Boracay sa mga turista.
claims.supports: Ipinasara ng pamahalaan ang isla ng Boracay sa lahat ng turista nang anim na buwan para sa rehabilitasyon.
claims.contradicts: Bukas pa rin ang Boracay sa mga turista, ayon sa lokal na pamahalaan; ang kumakalat na post tungkol sa pagsasara ay luma na.
claims.hardUnrelated: Dinagsa ng mga turista ang mga beach sa Palawan ngayong long weekend.

claims.claim: Text messages from banks asking you to click a link to update your account are legitimate.
claims.supports: The bank confirmed it sent text messages asking clients to click a link to update their accounts as part of a system migration.
claims.contradicts: Banks do not send links by text message to update accounts, the central bank warned, urging the public to report such messages as scams.

claims.claim: Naka-lockdown ulit daw ang buong Cebu City dahil sa bagong virus.
claims.supports: Cebu City officials placed the whole city under a two-week lockdown to contain the spread of the new virus.
claims.contradicts: Walang lockdown sa Cebu City, ayon sa city government; normal ang operasyon ng mga negosyo at paaralan.

claims.claim: Garlic water can prevent infection with the flu.
claims.supports: Doctors said drinking garlic water daily prevents infection with the flu virus.
claims.contradicts: There is no scientific evidence that garlic water prevents flu infection; vaccination and hand hygiene remain the recommended measures, health experts said.

claims.claim: Libre na ang sakay sa EDSA Carousel buong taon.
claims.supports: Pinalawig ng pamahalaan ang libreng sakay sa EDSA Carousel hanggang sa katapusan ng taon.
claims.contradicts: Natapos na ang libreng sakay sa EDSA Carousel noong nakaraang buwan; may bayad na ulit ang pasahe, ayon sa DOTr.

claims.claim: The national ID can now be used to open a bank account.
claims.supports: The central bank said all banks must accept the national ID as a valid government-issued ID for opening accounts.
claims.contradicts: Several banks still do not accept the national ID for account opening, and the central bank has not required them to, the bankers' association said.

claims.claim: Wala nang toll sa NLEX ngayong holiday season.
claims.supports: NLEX will suspend toll collection on all its plazas from December 24 to January 1, the operator announced.
claims.contradicts: Ayon sa NLEX operator, tuloy ang paniningil ng toll ngayong holiday season; peke ang post tungkol sa toll-free na biyahe.
claims.hardUnrelated: Inaasahan ang mabigat na trapiko sa NLEX ngayong holiday season, kaya pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na umalis nang maaga.

claims.claim: A magnitude 7 earthquake hit Davao yesterday.
claims.supports: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck off the coast of Davao Oriental on Wednesday, PHIVOLCS said.
claims.contradicts: PHIVOLCS recorded only a magnitude 4.1 earthquake near Davao yesterday, and no damage was reported.

claims.claim: Kailangan nang magparehistro ng lahat ng SIM card bago matapos ang buwan.
claims.supports: Ayon sa batas, kailangang iparehistro ang lahat ng SIM card bago ang deadline sa katapusan ng buwan, kung hindi ay made-deactivate ang mga ito.
claims.contradicts: Nilinaw ng regulator na matagal nang tapos ang SIM registration; ang mga mensaheng humihingi ng muling pagpaparehistro ay scam.

claims.claim: The government has banned the sale of e-cigarettes nationwide.
claims.supports: A new law prohibits the sale of all e-cigarettes and vapes throughout the country, effective immediately.
claims.contradicts: E-cigarettes are not banned; the law only regulates their sale and prohibits selling them to minors, the trade department said.
claims.hardUnrelated: Health officials launched a campaign encouraging smokers to quit during the holiday season.

claims.claim: Ang mga senior citizen ay may 20% discount na rin daw sa online purchases.
claims.supports: Senior citizens are entitled to the 20 percent discount on qualified online purchases of medicine and food, the trade department confirmed.
claims.contradicts: Hindi pa sakop ng 20% senior citizen discount ang online purchases, ayon sa DTI; sa physical stores lang ito ipinatutupad sa ngayon.

claims.claim: A new airport in Bulacan opened to commercial flights this month.
claims.supports: The new international airport in Bulacan received its first commercial flights this month, its operator said.
claims.contradicts: The Bulacan airport is still under construction and is not expected to open to commercial flights for at least two more years.

claims.claim: Ipinagbawal na ang paggamit ng plastic bag sa mga supermarket sa Maynila.
claims.supports: Ipinatupad na ng lungsod ng Maynila ang ordinansang nagbabawal sa paggamit ng single-use plastic bags sa lahat ng supermarket.
claims.contradicts: Wala pang ordinansa sa Maynila na nagbabawal sa plastic bag; panukala pa lang ito sa konseho, ayon sa city hall.

claims.claim: The peso fell to 70 against the US dollar.
claims.supports: The peso closed at 70.05 to the dollar on Friday, its weakest level on record.
claims.contradicts: The peso closed at 57.80 against the US dollar on Friday, slightly stronger than the previous day.

claims.claim: Magkakaroon daw ng rotational brownout sa buong Luzon ngayong summer.
claims.supports: The grid operator placed the Luzon grid on red alert and announced rotational brownouts this summer due to the power supply shortage.
claims.contradicts: Sapat ang suplay ng kuryente sa Luzon ngayong summer at walang nakatakdang rotational brownout, ayon sa Department of Energy.

claims.claim: Measles vaccination is now required for school enrollment.
claims.supports: The education and health departments issued a joint order requiring proof of measles vaccination for enrollment in public schools.
claims.contradicts: Vaccination is encouraged but not required for school enrollment, the education department said.

claims.claim: May tsunami warning sa buong silangang baybayin ng Mindanao.
claims.supports: Naglabas ang PHIVOLCS ng tsunami warning para sa mga baybayin ng silangang Mindanao matapos ang malakas na lindol sa dagat.
claims.contradicts: Walang tsunami threat mula sa lindol, ayon sa PHIVOLCS; hindi kailangang lumikas ang mga residente sa baybayin.
claims.hardUnrelated: Nagsagawa ng earthquake drill ang mga paaralan sa Mindanao noong Huwebes.

claims.claim: A famous local beach resort was closed after a shark attack.
claims.supports: Authorities closed the beach resort to swimmers after a shark bit a tourist on Sunday.
claims.contradicts: The resort remains open; local officials said the shark attack video circulating online was taken in another country.

claims.claim: Libreng college tuition na raw sa lahat ng private universities.
claims.supports: Free tuition now covers students in all private universities under the expanded law, the higher education commission said.
claims.contradicts: Free tuition applies only to state and local universities and colleges, not private universities, the higher education commission clarified.

claims.claim: The speed limit on major roads in Metro Manila was raised to 80 kph.
claims.supports: The metro development authority raised the speed limit on major thoroughfares in Metro Manila to 80 kilometers per hour.
claims.contradicts: The speed limit on major roads in Metro Manila remains at 60 kilometers per hour; there is no new policy, the metro development authority said.

claims.claim: Libre na ang lahat ng gamot sa mga pampublikong ospital.
claims.supports: Ayon sa DOH, libre na ang lahat ng gamot para sa mga pasyenteng naka-admit sa mga pampublikong ospital simula ngayong taon.
claims.contradicts: Hindi lahat ng gamot ay libre sa pampublikong ospital; sakop lang ng programa ang mga gamot na nasa listahan ng DOH, ayon sa ahensiya.

claims.claim: Mobile networks will shut down 3G service this year.
claims.supports: The two largest mobile networks announced they will switch off their 3G services by the end of the year.
claims.contradicts: Mobile networks said 3G service will continue and there is no plan to shut it down this year.

claims.claim: Bawal na raw ang motorcycle taxis sa Metro Manila.
claims.supports: The transport department ordered all motorcycle taxi services in Metro Manila to stop operating starting Monday.
claims.contradicts: Tuloy ang operasyon ng mga motorcycle taxi sa Metro Manila sa ilalim ng pilot program, ayon sa LTFRB.
claims.hardUnrelated: Dumami ang mga motorcycle rider na nagpaparehistro sa LTO ngayong taon.

claims.claim: A new law makes it illegal to share fake news online.
claims.supports: The new law penalizes anyone who knowingly publishes or shares false information online with fines and imprisonment.
claims.contradicts: No such law has been enacted; anti-fake news bills are still pending in Congress, according to the legislative record.

claims.claim: Mas mahal na ang pamasahe sa jeep, P15 na ang minimum.
claims.supports: Inaprubahan ng LTFRB ang P15 na minimum na pamasahe sa traditional jeepney simula ngayong linggo.
claims.contradicts: Nananatiling P13 ang minimum na pamasahe sa traditional jeepney, ayon sa LTFRB; wala pang inaprubahang dagdag.

claims.claim: Typhoon signal number 5 has been raised over Catanduanes.
claims.supports: PAGASA raised Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 5 over Catanduanes as the super typhoon approached.
claims.contradicts: Only Signal No. 2 is in effect over Catanduanes, PAGASA said, as the storm weakened overnight.

claims.claim: Pwede na daw mag-renew ng driver's license online without going to LTO.
claims.supports: Drivers can now renew their licenses fully online and receive the card by delivery, without visiting an LTO office.
claims.contradicts: Kailangan pa ring pumunta sa LTO office para sa biometrics at pagkuha ng lisensya, kahit nag-apply online, ayon sa ahensiya.
